summary: Text input that filters a popup list of violet-option children; use when the list is long enough that the user should search it.

usage.text: The value is the input text: after a choice, the option's label. The chosen option's value is the selectedOptionValue property, and the form receives that; raw text is submitted only when nothing is chosen.
To choose from script call selectValue(optionValue). Assigning the value property later changes only the text, not selectedOptionValue. An initial value may be an option's value or its label.

Typing filters by label, ignoring case and punctuation; arrow keys skip non-matching options, and "No matching options" shows when none match. Unchosen text is discarded on Tab, Escape or an outside press.

Choosing fires only change, with detail { value, selectedValue, label }. Typing fires input and a native commit fires change, each with { value, selectedValue }; selectedValue is empty for unchosen text.

The list opens on focus, typing and arrow keys, and the open attribute reflects it. show() opens it; hide(true) closes it and resets the text to the chosen option's label, or empties it when nothing is chosen.

a11y.text: Set label: without it the input has no programmatic label and browsers fall back to the placeholder. The popup list is named by the label, else the placeholder, else "Options".
Focus stays in the input; arrow keys move the highlighted option through aria-activedescendant and Enter chooses it.
The rendered error message is linked to the input as its description, after the supporting text.

roles.name: from the label attribute, else the placeholder
